LanguageData.Weazel_Essence.label: Essence
LanguageData.Weazel_Essence.description:
A specialized genetic substance extracted from various species, including humans. It is the most fundamental and indispensable resource in all Weazel engineering.

Essence is a specialized genetic substance discovered by the Weazels. Yielding particularly high quantities when extracted from males, this substance holds boundless potential and is absolutely vital to Weazel society. Depending on how it is processed, Essence can be utilized in everything from weaving textiles and cultivating artificial muscles to synthesizing pharmaceuticals and even recreational use. Essence is practically synonymous with Weazel culture; it is the lifeblood and driving force that shaped them into a race of predatory raiders.
While it is theoretically possible to harvest Essence from other creatures besides civilized humanoid races, doing so is considered a strict taboo even within Weazel society, an act so utterly abhorrent that no sane Weazel would ever even attempt it.
LanguageData.Weazel_Purified_Essence.label: Purified Essence
LanguageData.Weazel_Purified_Essence.description: Essence that has been rendered pure through a process of removing impurities and separating out unwanted compounds.
LanguageData.Weazel_EssentialSilk.label: Essence Silk
LanguageData.Weazel_EssentialSilk.description: A fabric woven from stretched Essence threads. Used as a material for Weazel apparel.\n\nA textile woven by extruding Essence into threads. Its silk-like softness and elasticity bear a disturbing resemblance to the texture of living skin. The raw Essence threads are manufactured during the weaving process via a mechanical device armed with countless micro-needles; this machine utilizes centrifugal force to spin the viscous liquid into microscopic filaments, braiding them tightly together like twine. Mimicking the structural principles of spider silk, this woven material offers impressive ballistic protection. Furthermore, thanks to the inherent thermal properties of raw Essence, specialized processing methods guarantee excellent body temperature regulation.
LanguageData.Weazel_GAM.label: G.A.M.
LanguageData.Weazel_GAM.description:
An artificial muscle essential for crafting Weazel power armor. Because it suffers from biological decay at room temperature, it must be kept frozen at sub-zero temperatures.

Genetic Amplified Muscle (G.A.M.) is a synthetic musculature cultivated using Essence. Fueled by Essence or chemical stimulants, G.A.M. is primarily utilized in the construction of power armor. Perfectly replicating biological biomechanics, G.A.M. consists of bundled artificial fibers capable of highly precise contraction and relaxation. By manipulating these fiber bundles, a vast array of muscular structures can be synthesized. Thanks to its extreme elasticity and durability, it serves as the core material for power armor, granting the wearer superhuman kinetic strength.
Its capacity for rapid mass production once incubation begins makes it the perfect material for a clone race like the Weazels. However, without a constant energy source, G.A.M. will begin to rot. Therefore, it must be kept in cryogenic storage to suspend its activity and maintain freshness.
LanguageData.Weazel.label: Weazel
LanguageData.Weazel.description:
An artificially cloned creation, the Weazel is a race that never originally existed.
Most of them are belligerent, as they inherit the personality of the original specimen they were cloned from.

The race is genetically all female, stands about 120cm tall on average, and is exceptionally cunning and quick.
Weazels are a common sight across the galaxy. They focus their raids on the Rim and have a particular fondness for abducting colonists. The reason is a special genetic substance called 'Essence,' which can only be extracted from races other than the Weazels themselves.
Essence is a vital resource in Weazel society, and the entire race lives like pirates in pursuit of high-quality Essence.
LanguageData.Weazel.tools.0.label: left claw
LanguageData.Weazel.tools.1.label: right claw
LanguageData.Weazel.tools.2.label: teeth
LanguageData.Weazel_Bodysuit_A.description: The most fundamental military uniform issued to Weazel forces.\n\nWeazels universally favor skin-tight garments like this bodysuit, as the form-fitting design perfectly complements and enhances their natural agility. Woven entirely from Essence Silk, the material's extreme elasticity allows it to function as a universal 'one-size-fits-all' garment, specifically calibrated to their standard 130cm stature. Boasting exceptional comfort and mild vacuum resistance, it serves as the mandatory base layer for all Weazel infantry, whether they are donning light skirmisher gear or piloting heavy power armor. Furthermore, the bodysuit alone provides a respectable degree of innate physical protection.
LanguageData.Weazel_Bodysuit_A.label: Weazel Bodysuit A
LanguageData.Weazel_Bodysuit_B.description: The most fundamental military uniform issued to Weazel forces.\n\nWeazels universally favor skin-tight garments like this bodysuit, as the form-fitting design perfectly complements and enhances their natural agility. Woven entirely from Essence Silk, the material's extreme elasticity allows it to function as a universal 'one-size-fits-all' garment, specifically calibrated to their standard 130cm stature. Boasting exceptional comfort and mild vacuum resistance, it serves as the mandatory base layer for all Weazel infantry, whether they are donning light skirmisher gear or piloting heavy power armor. Furthermore, the bodysuit alone provides a respectable degree of innate physical protection.
LanguageData.Weazel_Bodysuit_B.label: Weazel Bodysuit B
LanguageData.Weazel_Bodysuit_Officer.description: A bodysuit worn by Weazel officers.
LanguageData.Weazel_Bodysuit_Officer.label: Weazel Officer Bodysuit
LanguageData.Weazel_Duster.description: A duster designed to fully cover the wearer's torso and arms. Not only is it highly resilient against the harsh, rugged environments of the Rim, but its open-front cut ensures that a Weazel's natural agility remains completely unhindered.
LanguageData.Weazel_Duster.label: Weazel Duster
LanguageData.Weazel_WeazelFlakvest.description: A flak vest designed to protect the wearer's chest. Given their diminutive stature of roughly 130cm, Weazels consider this limited armor coverage to be more than sufficient. Because almost every enemy they encounter in combat towers over them, they firmly believe that, outside of fielding heavy power armor, unhindered mobility is the absolute key to maximizing survivability.
LanguageData.Weazel_WeazelFlakvest.label: Weazel Flak Vest
LanguageData.Weazel_WeazelHelmat.description: A standard-issue combat helmet featuring prominent, oversized ear housings on either side. The spacious interior provides ample clearance for the wearer's ears to twitch and pivot freely, while an integrated tactical headset system amplifies acoustic tracking to easily pinpoint enemy movements.
LanguageData.Weazel_WeazelHelmat.label: Weazel Combat Helmet
LanguageData.Weazel_MarderHelmat.description:
Provides better protection than a standard combat helmet, but falls short compared to other power armor helmets.

For the cloned Weazel race, 'individuality' is an obsession that far surpasses any desire for material wealth. The reality that their entire populace looks and thinks exactly alike has driven most Weazels into a desperate fixation on appearing different.
Consequently, the very first thing a Weazel does upon acquiring power armor is adorn her helmet with decorations meant to symbolize her 'unique' identity.

However, bound by the cognitive limitations of their cloned minds, they all inevitably think alike, meaning these desperate expressions of individuality almost always end up looking ironically identical.
LanguageData.Weazel_MarderHelmat.label: Weazel Marder Helmet
LanguageData.Weazel_MartenHelmat.description:
Provides better protection than a standard combat helmet, but falls short compared to other power armor helmets. It does not provide any pain suppression effects.

If you manage to survive an encounter with an armed Weazel raiding party, one of the most common sights left on the battlefield is a discarded Marten helmet, its interior thoroughly caked in blood and saliva.
The wearer of Marten armor is constantly pushed to the brink of extreme frenzy, whether engaged in active combat or merely standing on standby. As a result, they display razor-thin patience, frequently screaming and frothing at the mouth.

Weazel commanders exploit this volatile state by deploying Marten wearers at the absolute vanguard, using them to guarantee the survival of the assault squads pushing in behind them. Because of this tactical doctrine, donning Marten armor is widely regarded as a death sentence within Weazel society.

However, in a culture where survival is the ultimate testament to strength, returning alive from the meat grinder of melee combat is the absolute measure of power. Consequently, a surprisingly large number of Weazels willingly choose the Marten armor purely for the prestige it brings.
LanguageData.Weazel_MartenHelmat.label: Weazel Marten Helmet
LanguageData.Weazel_WolverineHelmat.description:
Equipped with a Cyclops lens, the Wolverine helmet is precision-engineered to maximize the wearer's marksmanship. Increases shooting accuracy.

While the Cyclops lens suffers from the severe drawback of drastically narrowing peripheral vision, it compensates by projecting a primary tactical HUD that rapidly acquires and pinpoints distant targets. This makes it perfectly optimized for establishing a supporting field of fire from the rear lines.
This targeting system allows a Wolverine, armed to the teeth with devastating heavy ordnance, to deliver surgical strikes against high-value targets.

To reiterate: surviving Weazels absolutely never utter the word 'Thicc' to a wearer's face, nor do they dare make any hand gestures implying it.
LanguageData.Weazel_WolverineHelmat.label: Weazel Wolverine Helmet
LanguageData.Weazel_MarderArmor.description:
The Marder is the most common standard-issue power armor manufactured for Weazels. While it offers comparatively lower protection than other power armors, its greatest strength is the superhuman force provided by its G.A.M. artificial muscles.

A true symbol of Weazel engineering, a wearer of the Marder armor can easily support over 100kg of weight without compromising her balance.

Weazels place immense faith in the strength and durability this suit provides to shatter their own physical limitations, and they gleefully revel in the thrill of firing massive heavy weapons that their natural bodies could never lift.
LanguageData.Weazel_MarderArmor.label: Weazel Marder Power Armor
LanguageData.Weazel_MartenArmor.description: The Marten is a modified power armor specialized for melee combat. It artificially inflates the wearer's pain threshold, allowing her to endure grievous injuries for extended periods. However, because she can fight past the point of collapse, the wearer is exceptionally likely to simply fight until death.\n\nThe Marten provides a dangerously simple function: maximum pain suppression. This is achieved not through conventional drugs, but via pheromones secreted directly from its Essence-fueled, modified G.A.M. musculature. Reeking of fresh blood, this substance is vented internally from the G.A.M., forcing the wearer to inhale it constantly and thrusting her into a state of violent frenzy. The awakened wearer is reduced to a rabid marten, obsessed only with charging forward to slaughter everything in sight. Due to these suicidal side effects, demand is highly niche. Consequently, the Marten stands as the cheapest and most readily available power armor for Weazels with 'specific' tastes.
LanguageData.Weazel_MartenArmor.label: Weazel Marten Power Armor
LanguageData.Weazel_WolverineArmor.description: The Wolverine is a heavy power armor that defies standard design specifications. Boasting exceptionally high armor ratings and brute kinetic strength, it is the optimal suit for wielding massive heavy weaponry.\n\nBuilt as a heavyweight juggernaut, the Wolverine is reinforced with reactive armor plating and powered by a specially modified, high-capacity G.A.M. musculature designed to support its own immense weight. Specialized for handling anti-tank ordnance and high-yield explosives, the armor's sheer bulk has earned it the nickname 'Thicc' armor among Weazels. While it is a rare sight on the battlefield, if you ever face one as an enemy, the gargantuan weapon in its wearer's hands will likely catch your eye long before her robust figure does. Just as a Wolverine wearer is incredibly hard to kill, she is invariably armed with devastating firepower capable of effortlessly killing anything else. Naturally, surviving Weazels know better than to ever utter the word 'Thicc' to a wearer's face.
LanguageData.Weazel_WolverineArmor.label: Weazel Wolverine Power Armor
LanguageData.Weazel_Bodysuit_Warder.description: A specialized bodysuit worn by Weazel wardens. It exerts a significant psychological effect, greatly increasing the suppression and obedience of nearby slaves.\n\nIn Weazel society, the role of a warden is a position of absolute authority and a display of power. Wardens are tasked with overseeing the captives designated for Essence extraction, placing them at the very forefront of the Essence production process. Weazels who become wardens are highly prone to becoming intoxicated by their own power, frequently deriving sadistic pleasure from dominating and subduing their prisoners. Consequently, to the captives under their watch, these wardens can be truly horrific entities.
LanguageData.Weazel_Bodysuit_Warder.label: Weazel Warden Bodysuit
LanguageData.Weazel_Wardenhat.description: A standard-issue cap worn by Weazel wardens. It enhances the wearer's ability to maintain the obedience of slaves.\n\nIt's a warden's cap. What more is there to say?
LanguageData.Weazel_Wardenhat.label: Weazel Warden Cap
LanguageData.Weazel_Slavesuit.label: Weazel Essence Slave Suit
LanguageData.Weazel_Slavesuit.description: A specialized slave uniform engineered with proprietary Weazel know-how. It periodically extracts Essence from the wearer, dropping the harvested product directly onto the floor.\n\nThis garment is custom-fitted for captives and equipped with a specialized extraction apparatus. Utilizing a device positioned at the wearer's crotch, it periodically harvests Essence, which is then discharged through a mechanism on the back. The exact method by which this Essence is extracted is a secret known only to the Weazels and the unfortunate wearer. As a bonus, it offers a surprisingly comfortable fit for a slave's daily life.
LanguageData.Weazel_BionicTail.label: Bionic Weazel Tail
LanguageData.Weazel_BionicTail.description: A Weazel tail whose artificial nature is impossible to spot at a glance. It corrects the user's gait, assisting their movement.
LanguageData.Weazel_BladeTail.label: Weazel Blade Tail
LanguageData.Weazel_BladeTail.description: The only thing better than an ordinary tail is a tail with a blade on it. Special, stylish, and quite handy for killing anyone who gets on your nerves.
LanguageData.WeazelColloidArm.label: Weazel Colloid Arm
LanguageData.WeazelColloidArm.description: A gel-like arm formed through Weazel technology.
LanguageData.WeazelBioGenerator.label: G.A.M. Bio-Generator
LanguageData.WeazelBioGenerator.description: A generator that produces electricity by harnessing the bio-thermic heat of G.A.M. Requires G.A.M. as fuel to generate power.\n\nG.A.M. is a ubiquitous material in Weazel society, notably repurposed even for power generation facilities. Shortly after discovering that sadistically stimulating the artificial muscle induces intense heat and a minor electrical charge, the majority of Weazel raiding outposts aggressively transitioned to G.A.M.-based power over standard chemfuel. After all, the very establishment of a Weazel raiding camp implies the active harvesting of Essence. Because G.A.M. can be cultivated with terrifying speed as long as Essence is plentiful, this method offers the massive advantage of a completely self-sustaining power supply.
LanguageData.WeazelEssenceWeaver.label: Essence Loom
LanguageData.WeazelEssenceWeaver.description: A mechanical device designed to weave Essence into textile materials.\n\nTransforming viscous, liquid Essence into workable fabric is a nearly impossible task without this machinery. First, extracted Essence is injected into a receptacle, where countless micro-needles stretch and spin the fluid in mid-air, temporarily solidifying it into microscopic fibers. These fibers are then braided together like twine and woven into usable threads. The underlying principle mimics a spider spinning its web: a conceptually simple but highly demanding process that strictly requires mechanical precision.
LanguageData.WeazelEssenceRefiner.label: Weazel Essence Refiner
LanguageData.WeazelEssenceRefiner.description: A Weazel Essence refinery. It currently has no function.\n\nIt purifies Essence through highly specialized processes. Weazel engineering is fundamentally built upon Essence, and refining it allows it to be utilized in a multitude of ways, from crafting sophisticated apparel to synthesizing potent pharmaceuticals. Naturally, such highly refined Essence is reserved for the upper castes of Weazel society.
LanguageData.WeazelGAMIncubation.label: G.A.M. Incubator
LanguageData.WeazelGAMIncubation.description: An incubator that cultivates G.A.M. artificial muscles using Essence. As long as Essence is periodically injected, it automatically produces G.A.M.\n\nThis vat nurtures a mass of artificial muscle that pulsates in reaction to Essence, behaving almost like a living organism. During the incubation phase, the G.A.M. writhes like tentacles, clumped together within the vat's nutrient fluid. When Essence is pumped through the lower intake chamber, the G.A.M. actively reacts, absorbing the fluid to fuel its growth. Few Weazels actually know the true nature of this material. Most are simply supplied with the base organic matter, knowing nothing more than the protocols required to cultivate and mass-produce it.
LanguageData.Weazel_EssenceSmokeleaf.label: Essence Blow
LanguageData.Weazel_EssenceSmokeleaf.description: An aerosolized form of Essence designed to be inhaled like smoke, carrying a deeply suggestive double entendre. It offers a pleasant mood boost with minimal risk of addiction.\n\nEssence Blow is the quintessential recreational indulgence in Weazel society, a clever play on words that leaves polite company blushing. Invented by a depraved Weazel artisan, this sultry luxury plays into the decadent vanity of inhaling the essence with puckered lips, quickly spreading as a wildly popular vice. By blending a hint of smokeleaf with refined Essence, it minimizes addictive properties while delivering a euphoric jolt to Weazels exhausted by grueling labor. Many a Weazel harbors a dark, salacious romanticism for taking a deep, breathless pull of Essence Blow to unwind after a brutal raid.
LanguageData.Bullet_Geckco.label: Weazel revolver bullet
LanguageData.Bullet_Viper.label: Weazel SMG bullet
LanguageData.Bullet_Mamba.label: Weazel battle rifle bullet
LanguageData.Bullet_Anaconda.label: Weazel LMG bullet
LanguageData.Bullet_Caiman.label: Weazel hunting rifle bullet
LanguageData.Bullet_Caiman_H.label: Weazel sniper bullet
LanguageData.Bullet_NineBarrelShotgun.label: Weazel nine-barrel shotgun pellet
LanguageData.Bullet_Alligator.label: autocannon HE shell
LanguageData.Bullet_Taipan.label: Weazel machine gun bullet
LanguageData.Weazel_BearSlam.label: Weazel Bear Slam
LanguageData.Weazel_BearSlam.description: A mechanized subjugation weapon forged in the shape of a massive bear's paw.\n\nOperating on mechanical principles, the Bear Slam is specifically engineered for subduing captives. Its primary purpose is to deliver a 'crushing blow,' utilizing its broad surface area to swat enemies into unconsciousness. However, when lethal force is required, the four razor-sharp claw blades mounted at the fingertips can inflict critical lacerations and induce heavy bleeding.
LanguageData.Weazel_BearSlam.tools.0.label: slam
LanguageData.Weazel_BearSlam.tools.1.label: claw
LanguageData.Weazel_Grizzly.label: Weazel Grizzly
LanguageData.Weazel_Grizzly.description: A multi-purpose falchion featuring a broad blade. Tailored to complement Weazel agility, it is remarkably lightweight yet capable of delivering devastating cleaving power thanks to its wide surface area, making it a highly favored melee weapon among Weazels.\nBeyond close-quarters combat, the Grizzly also serves as an exceptional utility tool, equally adept at chopping wood, clearing brush, and performing various other tasks on the Rim.
LanguageData.Weazel_Grizzly.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.Weazel_Grizzly.tools.1.label: blade
LanguageData.Weazel_Ermine.label: Weazel Ermine
LanguageData.Weazel_Ermine.description: The Ermine is a small, lightweight, and flat-profiled dagger featuring a ring at the pommel, specifically engineered for rapid deployment and immediate strikes.\n\nPrioritizing piercing over slashing, the Ermine is a weapon perfectly tailored to the small, agile Weazels. In combat, Weazels typically rush their targets at breakneck speed and drive the blade directly into vital organs.
LanguageData.Weazel_Ermine.tools.0.label: blade
LanguageData.Weazel_Ermine.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.Weazel_Ermine.tools.2.label: handle
LanguageData.Weazel_Badger.label: Weazel Badger
LanguageData.Weazel_Badger.description: The Badger is a 140cm long blunt weapon whose very design reflects the core purpose of the Weazels.\n\nIt was designed to 'capture,' rather than kill, targets far larger than its wielder. Taking advantage of a length that exceeds the average Weazel's height, it is swung two-handed with full centrifugal force behind each blow, making it optimal for incapacitating and subduing large hostiles.
LanguageData.Weazel_Badger.tools.0.label: head
LanguageData.Weazel_Badger.tools.1.label: handle
LanguageData.Weazel_ChihuahuaChainsaw.label: Weazel Chihuahua Chainsaw
LanguageData.Weazel_ChihuahuaChainsaw.description:
Measuring a staggering 130cm in length, the Chihuahua is a colossal chainsaw that functions more like a mechanized greatsword engineered by the Weazels. The moment its engine revs up, the deafening roar and violent shaking perfectly capture the spirit of its namesake: a furious Chihuahua.
Weazels who are obsessed with the visceral thrill of close-quarters combat naturally gravitate toward this weapon. Their preference, however, stems less from its practical combat efficiency and more from the sadistic entertainment of watching their enemies recoil in sheer terror. Rather than using it for steady cutting like a traditional chainsaw, Weazels frequently swing it wildly through the air like a greatsword, reveling in the panic it induces.

Despite its diminutive name, the weapon is as heavy as it looks. Wielding the Chihuahua unassisted is impractical; it is strongly recommended that it only be used while wearing power armor.
LanguageData.Weazel_ChihuahuaChainsaw.tools.0.label: head
LanguageData.Weazel_ChihuahuaChainsaw.tools.1.label: saw
LanguageData.Weazel_Geckco.label: Weazel Gecko Revolver
LanguageData.Weazel_Geckco.description: Designed for maximum portability, this compact revolver is built for sidearm carry. While its diminutive frame allows for a rapid draw during sudden emergencies, its large-caliber chambering guarantees highly reliable stopping power in close-quarters, anti-personnel combat.
LanguageData.Weazel_Geckco.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Weazel Gecko Revolver
LanguageData.Weazel_Geckco.tools.0.label: grip
LanguageData.Weazel_Geckco.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_Viper.label: Weazel Viper
LanguageData.Weazel_Viper.description: Engineered specifically for Weazel mobility, the Viper is characterized by its compact size, lightweight frame, and blistering rate of fire. Designed to rapidly unload a massive volume of lead into close-range targets, the Viper perfectly symbolizes the Weazel combat doctrine of utilizing their natural agility to swiftly close the distance on their prey.
LanguageData.Weazel_Viper.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Weazel Viper
LanguageData.Weazel_Viper.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.Weazel_Viper.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_Mamba.label: Weazel Mamba
LanguageData.Weazel_Mamba.description: The Mamba rifle is the most widely issued standard firearm among Weazel forces. Its reliable range, steady rate of fire, and solid accuracy are its greatest assets, making the weapon highly versatile and capable of adapting to almost any combat scenario.
LanguageData.Weazel_Mamba.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Weazel Mamba
LanguageData.Weazel_Mamba.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.Weazel_Mamba.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_Anaconda.label: Weazel Anaconda
LanguageData.Weazel_Anaconda.description: Engineered for battlefield suppression, the Anaconda is designed to rapidly lay down a hail of gunfire to pin down and halt advancing enemies.\nWhile its smaller caliber means it lacks outright lethality, its ability to instantly establish a blistering curtain of fire allows it to effortlessly suppress humans and even significantly larger hostiles.
LanguageData.Weazel_Anaconda.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Weazel Anaconda
LanguageData.Weazel_Anaconda.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.Weazel_Anaconda.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman.label: Weazel Caiman
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman.description: Resembling a grotesquely upscaled revolver, the Caiman is a long-range rifle chambered to hold six rounds of .50 caliber ammunition.\nEngineered to eliminate the most troublesome targets from afar, it boasts extreme range, devastating damage, and high armor penetration, all backed by highly reliable accuracy. However, its massive recoil and the slow reloading of its oversized munitions result in an abysmally low rate of fire. Yet even these flaws are completely overshadowed by its most glaring drawback: its sheer, agonizing weight, which leaves it barely portable on the battlefield.
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Weazel Caiman
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman_H.label: Weazel Caiman Long Barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman_H.description: A variant of the Caiman featuring a barrel extended to twice its original length. As a direct consequence, its overall weight has also doubled, making it impossible for standard infantry to wield. It is therefore fielded by power armor wearers.\n\nThe lengthened barrel provides a proportional increase to its maximum range, along with an equally devastating boost to its destructive power.
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman_H.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Weazel Caiman Long Barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman_H.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.Weazel_Caiman_H.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_NineBarrelShotgun.label: Hydra Shotgun
LanguageData.Weazel_NineBarrelShotgun.description: A shotgun featuring not two, not three, but nine individual barrels. Designed less for practical efficiency and purely for the sheer romance of overwhelming firepower, this weapon erupts with a storm of buckshot like a wall of flame from its nine muzzles, rapidly suppressing targets and inflicting catastrophic damage at close range.
LanguageData.Weazel_NineBarrelShotgun.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.Weazel_NineBarrelShotgun.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.Weazel_Alligator.label: Weazel Alligator
LanguageData.Weazel_Alligator.description: A massive, devastating heavy weapon created by fusing twin autocannons into a single platform, capable of rapidly unleashing a barrage of 25mm high-explosive rounds.\nIts overwhelming firepower and explosive payload effectively transform a standard infantryman into a walking armored vehicle. However, its crushing weight and absurd recoil make it impossible to operate without the highly precise contraction and relaxation of G.A.M. artificial muscles to absorb the punishment.\nConsequently, the Alligator is designed exclusively for power armor wearers.
LanguageData.Weazel_Alligator.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Weazel Alligator
LanguageData.Weazel_Alligator.tools.0.label: grip
LanguageData.Weazel_Taipan.label: Weazel Taipan
LanguageData.Weazel_Taipan.description: Most Weazels harbor a deep love for indiscriminate spray-and-pray. They are especially drawn to massive heavy weapons like the Taipan Minigun that can unleash spectacular storms of lead. This weapon perfectly embodies the fundamental spirit of Weazel engineering. While the Taipan Minigun's actual lethality is shockingly poor, the majority of Weazels derive immense pleasure from watching their enemies cower, pinned down by the sheer volume of fire unleashed in mere seconds. This perfectly aligns with the core Weazel ideology: rather than outright killing their targets, the goal is to crush their will to fight and secure them as intact 'livestock' for Essence. Naturally, due to its absurd recoil, the Taipan Minigun can only be wielded by those equipped with power armor.
LanguageData.Weazel_Taipan.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: Weazel Taipan
LanguageData.Weazel_Taipan.tools.0.label: grip
